title: Jurassic Park
about: A dinosaur theme park goes wrong when the power goes off.
cue: Serve dessert when Hammond eats melting ice cream in the dark visitor centre.
faces: You are among the very first guests to visit Isla Nublar. Before your tour sets off, our Visitor Center restaurant will look after you, and I have made sure of one thing above all: only the very best.
Every place to eat is numbered on the guest map inside.
The Brachiosaurus field, a short drive from the Visitor Center.
Electric cars guided along the tour road, with touch-screen narration. Please stay seated with hands inside.
10,000 volts. Please do not touch or lean on the fences.
Every tour car carries a pair for low light.
In the Visitor Center theatre, Mr. DNA shows you how we use frog DNA to fill in the gaps.
Stay in your vehicle. Park staff will guide every tour car back to the Visitor Center.
Menu items and prices subject to change.
Printed in U.S.A. Form VC-0193. © 1993 InGen.
Table service. Lunch 11:30 AM to 2:00 PM.
Minted pea puree, roast baby potatoes.
Vegetarian. Rice, beans, plantain, fried egg, slaw.
Vanilla bean, hot fudge, honeycomb candy.
Cane sugar, lemon peel, over ice.
Grab and go, beside the main hall.
Smoked chicken, avocado, cream cheese, chives.
Cold drinks to take on your tour car.
Please stay in your tour car at all times.

    StartersNedry's finger sandwichesSmoked chicken, avocado, cream cheese, chives.Gift Shop Counter, wrapped to go.How to make it150g cream cheese, softened1 bunch chives, snipped1 lemon1 ripe avocado250g smoked chicken, sliced8 slices of soft white bread1 pinch saltMix the cream cheese with the chives and the lemon zest.Mash the avocado with a squeeze of the lemon and the salt.Spread all the bread with the cream cheese. Top four slices with avocado and chicken and close with the rest.Press lightly, cut off the crusts and cut each into three fingers.Stack in a tin, cover and chill until serving.Raptor claw chipsClaw-cut tortilla chips, lime guacamole.Gift Shop Counter.How to make it6 flour tortillas2 tbsp vegetable oil1 tsp salt1 tsp smoked paprika3 avocados2 limes, juicedCut the tortillas into curved claw shapes.Brush with oil and sprinkle with half the salt and the smoked paprika.Bake at 200°C on lined trays until crisp.Mash the avocados with the lime juice and remaining salt for the guacamole. Serve with the crisps.MainsRosemary rack of lambMinted pea puree, roast baby potatoes.Visitor Center Restaurant, $19.93.How to make it2 lamb racks2 tbsp Dijon mustard1 bunch parsley, chopped50g breadcrumbs300g frozen peas1 small bunch mint30g butter800g baby potatoes2 tbsp olive oilBrush the lamb racks with Dijon, then press on the parsley and breadcrumbs.Toss the potatoes in oil and salt and put on a tray in a 220°C oven.Roast the lamb alongside the potatoes until 55°C inside, about 20 minutes.Rest the lamb 10 minutes while you boil the peas with the mint, drain and blitz with the butter. Slice the lamb and plate neatly.SweetsThe Founder’s sundaeVanilla bean, hot fudge, honeycomb candy.Mr. Hammond’s favourite.How to make it100g dark chocolate100ml thickened cream1 L vanilla ice cream100g honeycomb, crushedMelt the chocolate with the cream over low heat for hot fudge, stirring until smooth.Leave the ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much.Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter with crushed honeycomb.DrinksTour car iced teaBlack tea, honey, fresh mint.From the Tour Departure Kiosk.How to make it4 black tea bags1 L boiling water4 tbsp honey12 mint leaves, plus extra to serve3 limes1 bag iceBrew the tea bags in boiling water for 5 minutes, remove and stir in the honey.Cool, then chill for 2 hours (included in cook time).Muddle the mint with the juice of 2 limes in a jug, add the tea and stir.Fill tall clear glasses with ice, pour in the tea and garnish with lime wheels and mint.
